name: Selective TTS multi-agent data analysis pipeline

system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: each implemented as an agent with stage-specific prompts, powered by an LLM or a vision–language model (VLM)
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts live in mm_agents/prompts.py; stage-specific templates filled with dataset metadata.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: summarizes key metadata of the dataset (shape, schema, inferred types, small samples) and emits a concise metadata report
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: a structured profiling summary of the tabular dataset is injected up front rather than a directory listing; no agent-driven navigation tools.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: avoid streaming raw records to the model, improving robustness and efficiency
context_compaction.note: No condenser/summarizer of history described; each stage is a fresh prompted call with max 1500 tokens output.

observation_format.note: Rendered chart PNGs are passed to a vision-language judger/insight generator; metadata reports and insights are text.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: compiles executable plotting code; (iii) executes and, if needed, rectifies code using error traces
tool_call_format.note: No tool-calling API described; the visualizer emits Python plotting code that is executed (plot_i.py).

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: plot_{i}.py | Visualization code for the i-th direction
edit_primitive.note: Generated code is written out as a complete file per direction; no edit tool exists.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Table 1 provides prompt snippets for these judgers, designed with support from domain experts
tool_schema_source.note: No function-calling schemas; hand-authored prompts in mm_agents/prompts.py.

protocol_standardization.note: 14-file tree shows no MCP/A2A client; only OpenAI/vLLM endpoints configured.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: It comprises four stages, Data Profiling, Visualization, and Insight Generation and Judger Verification each implemented as an agent
loop_primitives.note: Default is the fixed four-stage pipeline; branching with stage-local pruning (branching_factor 5, pruning_ratio) gives tree_search/multi_attempt; code rectification from error traces gives generate_test_repair.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: emits a concise metadata report with plausible analysis directions
planning_granularity.note: directions.json / directions_raw.json store structured visualization directions (topic, chart_type, variables) consumed downstream.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: we build an end-to-end multi-agent pipeline for generating visually insightful charts and report of given dataset
multi_agent_topology.note: Fixed hand-off: profiling -> visualization -> insight generation -> judger.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: stage-local evaluators that prune weak candidates before passing results downstream
delegation_mechanism.note: Control passes stage to stage; no dynamic subagent spawning tool.

human_in_loop.note: Batch CLI run with no approval flags; human annotators only evaluate outputs offline.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: insights_validated.json # Pruned insights with detailed scores
short_term_state.note: Per-run state is a set of structured JSON artifacts (metadata report, directions, insights, scores, budget) rather than a message list.

long_term_memory.note: Artifacts are per-run outputs; nothing is re-injected into later runs.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Our implementation dynamically monitors the accumulated budget during execution and incrementally supplements additional runs until the target budget is reached
state_persistence.note: Intermediate artifacts and budget logs are persisted per run; no documented resume path, so this is a weak checkpoint reading.

self_verification.evidence_quote: filters meaningless figures via a chart judger
self_verification.note: Stage-local LLM judgers plus final judger (majority_judger_num 3); code execution errors feed rectification, but no test suite.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: executes and, if needed, rectifies code using error traces
retry_policy.note: Branching factor 5 candidates per stage with pruning is the main multi-attempt mechanism; repair attempts on failed plotting code.

rollback.evidence_quote: some branches fail quality gates or execution and are dropped
rollback.note: Failed branches are discarded rather than reverted; no git/snapshot machinery.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: we hold the total compute constant across all pruning configurations Compute is measured by the number of LLM calls
termination_condition.note: Runs end when the fixed LLM-call (or token) budget is reached; max_tokens=1500 caps each generation; pipeline also simply ends after its final stage.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Given a baseline budget B (ρ=0), we adjust the number of runs such that the total LLM calls under each pruning ratio ρ closely matches B.
cost_controls.note: token_count flag and budget_used.txt track spend; separate --generation_model and --judge_model assign cheaper/stronger models per role.

timeouts.note: No timeout parameter in the documented CLI; budgets are call/token based.

execution_isolation.note: Generated plotting code runs locally in the conda environment via process/thread executors; no container isolation documented.

filesystem_access.note: Code executes with the user's own permissions on the host; results written under --workdir.

network_policy.note: No network restriction mechanism mentioned; API/vLLM calls go out freely.

permission_model.evidence_quote: compiles executable plotting code; (iii) executes and, if needed, rectifies code using error traces
permission_model.note: Model-generated code is executed without any allowlist or approval gate.

tracing.note: Per-run JSON artifacts (directions_raw, insights_raw with reasoning process, scores, result_summary) plus a budget log.

replayability.evidence_quote: insights_raw.json     # Raw insights with reasoning process
replayability.note: Artifacts allow post-hoc analysis but no replay runner; generation is stochastic at temperature 1.0.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: scores.json             # Mean insight score for this run
eval_hooks.note: mm_agents/meta_judger.py and the final judger stage score outputs within the repo, and datasets/VIS.csv ships as the evaluation data.

guardrails.evidence_quote: filters meaningless figures via a chart judger
guardrails.note: Closest value: quality gates block low-quality artifacts from moving downstream; no safety guardrails as such.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Grounded in the data science pipeline, we build an end-to-end multi-agent pipeline for generating visually insightful charts and report of given dataset
target_domain.note: Data-science/visual-insight generation (other); framed as a step toward scientific discovery (research).

open_source.evidence_quote: Our code and generated reports are publicly available
open_source.note: Public GitHub repo; no LICENSE file visible in the 14-path tree, so licence unconfirmed.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: If you want to use vLLM to deploy Hugging Face models locally
model_agnostic.note: OpenAI API and any vLLM-served HF model supported via --generation_model / --judge_model.

primary_artifact.note: Coded from the repo at commit 0588b3c8f441, which accompanies arXiv:2512.22650.

first_release_date.note: Basis: paper v1 date; no tagged release in the repo.

pinned_version.note: No tags; untagged main branch commit.

stars.note: Star count as recorded in the provided repository evidence header.
